verdict.rationale: Alacritty ships an official CLI binary with an `alacritty msg` IPC subcommand that can script actions such as `create-window`, so a user or agent can drive it from the command line. Evidence shows only a narrow command surface and nothing tailored to AI-native workflows. The macOS install probe failed because the Homebrew cask was disabled, so runtime control was never exercised; that is an install problem, not a contradiction of the CLI. Missing for 10: a documented command surface beyond window creation, machine-readable output for agents, any AI-oriented workflow support, and hands-on verification of `alacritty msg`.
